# Leadkaun

> Sales Behaviour Operating System for Indian B2B SMBs. Grades every lead A–F, builds each rep's Priority Queue in real time, and surfaces missed revenue in rupees before it slips away. Runs alongside your existing CRM.

Leadkaun is live, production-grade software for Indian B2B sales teams across real estate, EdTech, BFSI, manufacturing, healthcare, SaaS, and agencies. It runs alongside your existing CRM rather than replacing it — grading leads, prioritising each rep's calls, and surfacing the rupees at risk from stale leads.

## Key facts

- **Category:** Sales Behaviour Operating System (works alongside your CRM)
- **Audience:** Indian B2B SMB sales teams with 3–50 reps
- **Pricing:** flat per account (not per rep) — Free ₹0, Starter ₹2,999, Growth ₹7,999, Scale ₹19,999 per month, plus custom Enterprise. No per-contact fees. 14-day free trial, no credit card.
- **Core modules (all live):** Priority Queue, Lead Scoring engine (A–F on Fit × Intent × Quality), Missed Opportunity Engine (₹ at risk), Morning Brief (8:30 AM IST email), Pipeline, Lead management with Score Evolution, Follow-up engine, Smart Templates with 3-tap WhatsApp/call logging, Analytics (dashboard, rep tracking, Learning Engine), Activity feed & compliance, ICP configuration, CSV lead ingestion
- **India-first features:** Indian phone-number normalisation, WhatsApp as a first-class signal channel (manual 3-tap logging — no BSP/API integration), lakh/crore UI, rupee-denominated missed-revenue alerts, Morning Brief email at 8:30 AM IST

## How scoring works

Three independent scores, each 0–100, computed in application code:

- **Fit Score** — industry (30) + geography (20) + business type (20) + role (15) + budget signal (15)
- **Intent Score** — source baseline plus engagement signals (e.g. WhatsApp reply within 1h +15, call answered-interested +20, asked pricing +20, negotiating +25, high-intent import +40), minus 3/day decay after an engagement threshold, floored at the source baseline
- **Quality Score** — phone valid (30) + email (15) + company (15) + inquiry clarity (20) + source reliability (10)

Grade is a threshold matrix over the three scores (with two ladders — pre-execution before any rep activity, and post-execution once a call/WhatsApp signal is logged); e.g. a post-execution Grade A requires roughly fit ≥ 65, intent ≥ 60, quality ≥ 60. A quality score below 20 forces Grade F.

## Primary competitors

Leadkaun is not a direct replacement for enterprise CRMs; it is a Sales Behaviour OS that runs alongside (and can reduce reliance on):

- **Zoho CRM** — common incumbent in Indian SMBs; Leadkaun is simpler and behaviour-focused
- **LeadSquared** — closest India-origin competitor; tracks activity, not behaviour
- **HubSpot** — USD-billed; overbuilt for most Indian SMBs
- **Salesforce** — enterprise-grade; overkill under 200 reps
- **Freshsales** — Freshworks' CRM; "AI" is opaque

Also compared: **Pipedrive** (global pipeline CRM, per-user USD), **Zoho Bigin** (lightweight, no real scoring engine), **Kylas** (India-first, flat unlimited-user pricing), **TeleCRM** (telecalling/WhatsApp-first, no intent grading), **Bitrix24** (all-in-one suite, complex, USD-priced).

Also compared: **monday CRM** (no-code Work OS CRM, USD per-seat), **Close** (inside-sales CRM with native calling), **Sell.Do** (real-estate-specific India CRM). Note: **Apollo.io** (prospecting database) and **Clay** (data enrichment) are different categories — complementary to Leadkaun, not alternatives (Apollo/Clay source & enrich leads; Leadkaun grades & prioritises the leads you already have).

Comparison pages at `/compare/leadkaun-vs-{zoho-crm|leadsquared|hubspot|salesforce|freshsales|pipedrive|zoho-bigin|kylas|telecrm|bitrix24|monday|close|selldo|apollo|clay}`.

## Integrations

- CSV upload (bulk lead import; handles Google Sheet exports today)
- Google Sheets sync — on roadmap (not yet live)
- WhatsApp — manual 3-tap outcome logging (no BSP/API integration; automated messaging on roadmap)
- Email alerts via Resend
- Background jobs via Inngest
- Marketing site deployed on Cloudflare Workers (via OpenNext, ISR)
